battle.name: 達吉斯坦戰爭
battle.brief: 達吉斯坦戰爭於一九九九年九月在達吉斯坦共和國爆發，初始階段為俄羅斯聯邦軍與武裝團體間的戰事，亦被視為第二次車臣戰爭的開端。裝備項目所指的 Ironclad（鐵甲艦），是英國海軍十九世紀已列裝的戰鬥艦艇類別，歸入戰鬥艦隊序列。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: Ironclad 是英國皇家海軍十九世紀的鐵甲戰艦類別，置於戰鬥艦隊序列，承擔海上警戒、封鎖與遠洋部署，是當時海軍火力的重要構成。

countries: 交戰雙方是俄羅斯聯邦與未被聯合國承認的車臣共和國（Ichkeria）割遂武裝。達吉斯坦共和國不是另一個交戰國，而是俄羅斯聯邦內的一個聯邦主體；當地內務部隊、民兵、國防部部隊、聯邦安全局與總參情報部均屬俄方作戰序列。俄方以北高加索軍區為後方，戰區由馬哈奇卡拉、布因納克、哈薩維尤爾特伸向達吉斯坦東南部，再越過車臣邊境，涵蓋博特利赫、庫爾恰洛伊、阿奇霍伊馬爾坦、沙利與阿爾貢河谷。車臣一方則以沙米爾·巴耶耶夫建立的割據政府為核心，由車臣游擊隊及達吉斯坦武裝支部配合作戰，沒有外國以國家身份投入常規部隊。戰役由達吉斯坦境內的武裝越境引起，卻迅速變成決定車臣南部控制權的聯合作戰。
countriesEn: The belligerents were the Russian Federation and the armed forces of the unrecognized Chechen Republic of Ichkeria. The Republic of Dagestan was not a separate belligerent country but a federal subject within Russia; its Interior Ministry troops, local militia, Ministry of Defense units, Federal Security Service personnel, and Main Intelligence Directorate units all formed part of the Russian side. Russia used the North Caucasus Military District as its rear area. The theater extended from Makhachkala, Buynaksk, and Khasavyurt into southeastern Dagestan, then crossed the Chechen border to cover Botlikh, Kurchaloy, Achkhoy-Martan, Shali, and the Argun valley. The Chechen side was centered on the separatist government established by Shamil Basayev and operated with Chechen guerrilla formations and Dagestani armed detachments; no foreign state committed regular troops to either side. The campaign began as an armed incursion into Dagestan but rapidly became a joint operation determining control over southern Chechnya.
people: 俄方最高決策由總統波里斯·葉爾欽授權，總理弗拉基米爾·普京主持跨部門協調，武裝部隊總司令阿納托利·克瓦什寧負責最高軍事指揮，北方高加索方向的前線指揮則集中於第58集團軍司令弗拉基米爾·克瓦昌里拉德澤。克瓦昌里拉德澤把指揮所設在布因納克，負責哈薩維尤爾特、塔爾克紹伊、博特利赫至阿爾貢一線的第58集團軍作戰；第29集團軍、空降兵及工程、通信單位隨後投入。達吉斯坦總統馬哈茂德阿里·馬哈茂多夫負責地方行政與民兵動員，聯邦安全局局長尼古拉·帕特魯舍夫指揮安全部門特遣隊。車臣方面，沙米爾·巴耶耶夫是割據政府的政治與軍事領袖，其弟馬哈茂德·多卡·巴耶耶夫參與發動最初的越境行動；沙特出生的老兵卡塔卜負責達吉斯坦與博特利赫方向的戰術指揮，阿斯蘭·馬什哈多夫則以參謀長身分主持軍令、部署與後方整編。這條指揮鏈說明，聯邦軍雖由中央統籌，地面清剿、地方維安與情報行動卻分屬不同系統。
peopleEn: At the highest level, Russian President Boris Yeltsin authorized the use of federal force, Prime Minister Vladimir Putin coordinated the relevant agencies, and Commander-in-Chief Anatoly Kvashnin exercised overall military command. Front-line command in the North Caucasus was concentrated in the 58th Combined Arms Army under Vladimir Kvachantiradze. Kvachantiradze established his headquarters at Buynaksk and commanded the corridor running from Khasavyurt and Tarkshoi through Botlikh toward Argun. The 29th Combined Arms Army, airborne units, and engineering and communications support followed. Dagestan President Magomedali Magomedov handled local administration and militia mobilization, while Federal Security Service director Nikolai Patrushev directed security-service detachments. On the Chechen side, Shamil Basayev was the political and military leader of the separatist government, and his brother Magomed Dokka Basayev participated in the initial incursion. The Saudi-born veteran Khattab commanded operations in Dagestan and around Botlikh, while Aslan Maskhadov served as chief of staff for orders, deployment, and rear-area reorganization. This command structure shows that federal operations were centrally coordinated but divided among the regular army, local security forces, and intelligence-led actions.
kits: 可確認投入作戰的俄軍裝備包括T-72B與T-72BV主力坦克、T-80U及少量T-80UD、BMP-1與BMP-2步兵戰車、BTR-70與BTR-80裝甲運兵車、MT-LB履帶式多用途車；炮兵使用2S1「金屬花」122毫米自行榴彈炮、2S3「鬱金香」152毫米自行榴彈炮與BM-21「冰雹」122毫米火箭炮。航空兵運用Mi-8與Mi-24直昇機、Su-24戰鬥轟炸機、MiG-29及Su-27戰鬥機，Il-76則承運彈藥、燃料與其他重型補給。步兵使用AK-74、AKM、PKM通用機槍、SVD狙擊槍、DShK重機槍，並配備RPG系列反裝甲武器。BMP-2可使用9M14「小可愛」反裝甲飛彈與2A42機炮。車臣武裝大量運用從蘇軍庫存取得或由俄軍裝備中繳獲的AK-74、AKM、RPK-74、PKM、SVD、DShK與RPG-7；部分小隊使用2B11 120毫米迫擊炮，也取得或使用2B14 152毫米迫擊炮。相應實彈包括5.45毫米與7.62毫米步槍彈、7.62×54毫米機槍彈、14.5毫米重機槍彈，以及125毫米坦克炮彈、122毫米和152毫米炮彈、120毫米迫擊炮炸藥。俄軍航空作戰使用FAB-250、FAB-500等通用炸彈與Mi-24火箭及機炮。各部隊實際配備數量與優先順序不同，不能把俄軍完整裝備清單視為每一分隊同時具備。
kitsEn: Confirmed Russian equipment in the campaign included T-72B and T-72BV main battle tanks, T-80U and a small number of T-80UDs, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-70 and BTR-80 armored personnel carriers, and MT-LB tracked utility vehicles. The artillery inventory included 2S1 Gvozdika 122 mm self-propelled howitzers, 2S3 Akatsiya 152 mm self-propelled howitzers, and BM-21 Grad 122 mm rocket launchers. The air arm employed Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters, Su-24 strike aircraft, MiG-29 and Su-27 fighters, while Il-76 transports carried ammunition, fuel, and other heavy supplies. Infantry used AK-74 and AKM rifles, PKM general-purpose machine guns, SVD sniper rifles, DShK heavy machine guns, and RPG-series anti-tank weapons. BMP-2 vehicles could employ 9M14 Malyutka guided missiles and 2A42 autocannons. Chechen forces extensively used AK-74, AKM, RPK-74, PKM, SVD, DShK, and RPG-7 weapons taken from Soviet stocks or captured from Russian units. Some detachments used 2B11 120 mm mortars and obtained or employed 2B14 152 mm mortars. The corresponding ammunition included 5.45 mm and 7.62 mm rifle cartridges, 7.62×54 mm machine-gun ammunition, 14.5 mm heavy-machine-gun ammunition, 125 mm tank rounds, 122 mm and 152 mm rounds, and 120 mm mortar explosive rounds. Russian aviation employed FAB-250 and FAB-500 general-purpose bombs together with Mi-24 rockets and cannon fire. Equipment quantities and priorities differed between units, so the Russian inventory should not be treated as the simultaneous holdings of every subunit.
tactics: 第一階段發生於一九九九年八月十四日至九月初。沙米爾·巴耶耶夫與馬哈茂德·多卡·巴耶耶夫率武裝越過車臣邊境，在布因納克奪取武器與行政檔案，並試圖以山區據點和武裝人員控制達吉斯坦東部交通線。俄方最初以內務部隊和當地民兵封鎖道路，發現輕裝分隊不足以清掉分散陣地後，才投入第58集團軍、炮兵、Mi-24與Mi-8直昇機。聯邦特遣隊夜間進入山區搜索車臣指揮官，航空兵則反覆攻擊道路沿線陣地；巴耶耶夫武裝在補給與指揮受到壓迫後退回車臣。第二階段始於九月五日，第58集團軍越過邊界，沿哈薩維尤爾特至塔爾克紹伊方向推進，同時以博特利赫方向形成南翼。九月十六日，博特利赫攻勢受挫。車臣武裝封鎖道路，從側翼攻擊俄軍先頭車隊、指揮與後勤節點，迫使裝甲車隊停進，步兵下車後再以炮兵和航空火力打開通路。俄軍隨後改用更大縱深的步兵 clearing unit、持續炮火準備及反覆空襲，至九月下旬才重新控制博特利赫。十月起，俄軍由庫爾恰洛伊向阿奇霍伊馬爾坦、沙利及阿爾貢方向逐步推進；車臣部隊避免在主要公路正面固守，轉而依托山脊、河谷與村鎮外圍，攻擊側翼、巡邏隊和後方補給線。十一月以後，阿爾貢與沙利方向的反擊使前進速度下降。十二月的作法轉為鞏固據點、清理道路、保護燃料與彈藥車隊，再由步兵、特種部隊和直昇機向山地搜索。聯邦軍因此取得南線主動權，但每推進一段都必須處理狹窄道路、障礙物、山地天候及游擊滲透，遠非一次連續攻佔即可完成。
tacticsEn: The first phase ran from 14 August to the beginning of September 1999. Shamil Basayev and Magomed Dokka Basayev crossed the Chechen border, seized weapons and administrative records in Buynaksk, and attempted to use mountain positions and armed personnel to control transport routes in eastern Dagestan. Russia initially relied on Interior Ministry troops and local militia to block the roads. After lightly equipped detachments proved unable to clear dispersed positions, the 58th Combined Arms Army, artillery, Mi-24s, and Mi-8 helicopters entered the operation. Federal detachments searched the mountains for Chechen commanders at night, while aircraft repeatedly attacked positions along the roads. Pressure on Basayev's supply and command structure forced his forces back into Chechnya. The second phase began on 5 September, when the 58th Combined Arms Army crossed the border and advanced along the Khasavyurt–Tarkshoi axis while forming a southern flank toward Botlikh. The offensive in Botlikh failed on 16 September. Chechen forces blocked the roads, struck the Russian vanguard, command vehicles, and logistics nodes from the flanks, and forced armored columns to halt while infantry dismounted. Russian artillery and aviation then opened a path. Larger, deeper infantry formations, sustained preparatory fire, and repeated airstrikes were subsequently used, and Botlikh was not recaptured until late September. From October, Russian forces advanced through Kurchaloy toward Achkhoy-Martan, Shali, and Argun. Chechen formations avoided prolonged frontal defense on the main roads and instead used ridges, river valleys, and positions outside settlements to strike flanks, patrols, and supply lines. Counterattacks around Argun and Shali slowed the advance in November. During December, the Russian method changed to securing strongpoints, clearing roads, protecting fuel and ammunition convoys, and then sending infantry, special forces, and helicopters into the mountains. Federal forces gained the initiative on the southern axis, but every advance required clearance of narrow roads, obstacles, mountain weather, and guerrilla infiltration.
data: 時間與兵力上的可靠錨點包括：八月十四日武裝越境，九月五日聯邦軍由達吉斯坦正式越界進入車臣，九月十六日博特利赫攻勢失利，九月下旬該地重被俄軍控制，十月初聯邦軍推進至庫爾恰洛伊，十月至十一月逐步控制沙利、阿爾貢等南部節點，十二月的戰線則向韋捷諾與阿爾貢河谷上游延伸。八月作戰序列以第58集團軍、內務部隊及聯邦安全局單位為主；九月南部戰線展開後，第29集團軍、空降兵和工程通信部隊陸續加入，戰區地面兵力由一萬餘人增至數萬量級。第131獨立摩托化步兵旅是博特利赫方向的重要地面單位，其前進必須依靠坦克、步兵戰車與後方步兵共同掩護。主要北方補給線由馬哈奇卡拉經布因納克、哈薩維尤爾特通往塔爾克紹伊，南線則以博特利赫、庫爾恰洛伊及阿奇霍伊馬爾坦為節點。2S1、2S3與BM-21所需炮彈由縱隊運往前線，Mi-8分送較小批補給，Il-76負責較大件物資；燃料、潤滑油、履帶備件與拖曳設備也隨機械化部隊消耗。-damaged車輛先由拖曳車送回達吉斯坦或已控制城鎮的修理區，而不是在戰線旁即時恢復。秋季降雨、低雲與山區能見度限制了直昇機和固定翼航空兵活動，也延長道路勤務時間。傷亡只能作量級判讀：公開的俄方彙總顯示聯邦軍在1999年付出數千名死亡與失聯，車臣方面沒有同等可靠的總表；博特利赫等戰鬥的個別傷亡數互相矛盾，因此不列任何單一精確數字。
dataEn: The reliable chronological anchors are 14 August for the armed incursion, 5 September for the federal entry into Chechnya from Dagestan, 16 September for the failed offensive at Botlikh, late September for the town’s recapture, early October for the advance to Kurchaloy, October and November for the gradual consolidation of Shali and Argun, and December for a front extending toward Vedeno and the upper Argun valley. The August order of battle centered on the 58th Combined Arms Army, Interior Ministry troops, and Federal Security Service units. After the southern front opened in September, the 29th Combined Arms Army, airborne troops, and engineering and communications units entered, raising the theater's ground force from somewhat over ten thousand to a force measured in tens of thousands. The 131st Separate Motor Rifle Brigade was an important ground formation in the Botlikh sector, where its advance depended on tanks, infantry fighting vehicles, and infantry protection. The principal northern supply route ran from Makhachkala through Buynaksk and Khasavyurt to Tarkshoi, while the southern axis ran through Botlikh, Kurchaloy, and Achkhoy-Martan. Ammunition for 2S1, 2S3, and BM-21 systems moved forward in convoys, Mi-8s delivered smaller loads, and Il-76s handled larger supplies. Fuel, lubricants, track spares, and towing equipment were consumed at the same rate as the mechanized formations. Damaged vehicles were towed back to repair areas in Dagestan or secured towns rather than restored beside the front. Autumn rain, low cloud, and mountain visibility restricted both helicopter and fixed-wing aviation and lengthened road-service times. Casualties can only be judged by order of magnitude: public Russian summaries place federal military dead and missing in the thousands during 1999, while no equally reliable comprehensive total exists for the Chechen side. Individual casualty figures for battles such as Botlikh conflict across sources, so no single precise number is used here.
cause: 遠因是一九九四至一九九六年第一次車臣戰爭留下的未解決局面。俄軍撤離後，車臣維持事實上的獨立政治與軍事秩序，雙方就解除武裝、邊境及權力安排的反覆磋商沒有形成可執行協議。直接原因則是一九九九年八月十四日，沙米爾·巴耶耶夫及其弟馬哈茂德·多卡·巴耶耶夫決定把車臣戰線向達吉斯坦延伸，以奪取軍械與行政檔案，建立後方基地，並利用達吉斯坦境內既有武裝網路形成另一條補給與機動走廊。越境者在布因納克及周邊山地取得武器、設置路障並試圖控制部分行政節點，使事件迅速越過一般邊境緝捕的範圍。俄羅斯最初把任務交給內務部隊與當地民兵，但地方武力未能持續占據山區與道路；葉爾欽隨後授權國防部、空軍及安全機構投入兵力。於是衝突由邊境武裝滲入、對達吉斯坦控制權的爭奪，轉化為聯邦軍在車臣南部建立持久戰線的戰役。
causeEn: The underlying cause was the unresolved situation left by the 1994–1996 First Chechen War. After the Russian withdrawal, Chechnya retained a de facto independent political and military order, while repeated negotiations over disarmament, borders, and the division of authority failed to produce an enforceable settlement. The immediate cause was the decision on 14 August 1999 by Shamil Basayev and his brother Magomed Dokka Basayev to extend the Chechen front into Dagestan. Their aim was to seize weapons and administrative records, establish rear bases, and use the existing armed network in Dagestan to create another supply and maneuvering corridor. The infiltrators obtained weapons around Buynaksk, established roadblocks, and attempted to control several administrative nodes, quickly taking the conflict beyond the scale of a routine border security operation. Russia initially assigned the mission to Interior Ministry troops and local militia, but local forces could not maintain continuous possession of the mountains and roads. Yeltsin then authorized the Ministry of Defense, aviation, and security agencies to commit troops. The conflict consequently developed from an armed border incursion and a struggle for control in Dagestan into a campaign to establish a durable federal front in southern Chechnya.
impact: 達吉斯坦戰役首先改變了雙方的地理與作戰條件。俄軍不再只守邊境，而是控制博特利赫、庫爾恰洛伊及阿爾貢方向的道路，使車臣割據武裝失去達吉斯坦方向的主要基地，許多游擊小組被迫向車臣內陸和更難接近的山區移動。聯邦軍則由有限度警察行動轉入長期聯合作戰，建立裝甲突進、步兵清剿、炮兵火力與航空支援相互配合的體系。戰役同時暴露山區道路狹窄、補給線脆弱、直昇機受天候限制，以及道路障礙與伏擊對車隊的持續消耗；後續因此更重視工程保障、巡邏分隊、交替掩護與占領後鞏固。車臣武裝則避免與俄軍正面爭奪主要公路，轉而利用分散的小型步兵單位、反裝甲武器、狙擊與迫擊炮襲擊側翼和後方，使聯邦軍推進速度受到制約。到1999年底，戰略主動權已轉向聯邦軍，但車臣仍有縱深部隊與游擊網絡，這場戰役因而只是全面車臣戰爭的開端，不是最終解決。
impactEn: The Dagestan campaign first changed the geographic and operational conditions on both sides. Russia was no longer merely guarding a border: control of Botlikh, Kurchaloy, and the roads toward Argun deprived the Chechen separatist forces of their principal base in Dagestan and pushed many guerrilla groups deeper into Chechnya and into less accessible mountains. The federal campaign changed from a limited police operation into a sustained joint effort built around armored advances, infantry clearance, artillery fire, and aviation support. It also exposed the effects of narrow mountain roads, vulnerable supply lines, weather restrictions on helicopters, and repeated harassment of convoys by mines, obstacles, and ambushes. Russian forces consequently placed greater emphasis on engineering support, smaller patrols, alternating protection, and consolidation after taking ground. Chechen formations avoided direct contests for the principal highways and relied instead on dispersed infantry groups, anti-tank weapons, sniper fire, and mortars to strike flanks and rear areas, slowing the federal advance. By the end of 1999 the strategic initiative had shifted to Russia, but Chechnya still retained forces and networks in the interior. The campaign was therefore the opening phase of the wider Chechen war rather than a final resolution.
result: 以一九九九年十二月三十一日為第一階段界線，俄方取得了明確的達吉斯坦戰役成果。聯邦軍已將越境武裝逐出達吉斯坦，重新控制博特利赫，並在車臣南部掌握庫爾恰洛伊、沙利、阿爾貢及主要公路與後方補給節點；九月受挫的博特利赫攻勢最終轉為俄軍控制，車臣割據武裝則失去南部主體與縱深縱隊，退向山區及更北區域。這不是車臣全境的終局。游擊隊仍能以小隊作戰、伏擊巡邏與襲擊補給線，聯邦軍也仍需清理山地、鞏固道路並向車臣中部推進；戰鬥延續至2000年第一季度，南線才逐漸連成較穩定的控制走廊。因此，若只論1999年的達吉斯坦階段，結果是俄羅斯取得戰術與戰略主動權、割據武裝未能建立達吉斯坦根據地；若論整場後續車臣戰爭，1999年的結果是俄軍打開南部進攻軸線並迫使對方退卻，而不是全面勝負已經確定。
resultEn: Using 31 December 1999 as the boundary of the first phase, Russia achieved a clear result in the Dagestan campaign. Federal forces had expelled the armed incursion from Dagestan, regained Botlikh, and established control over Kurchaloy, Shali, Argun, and the principal roads and logistics nodes in southern Chechnya. The Botlikh offensive that had failed in September ultimately ended under Russian control, while the separatist forces lost their southern base and main formations, withdrawing toward the mountains and more northerly areas. This did not settle the whole of Chechnya. Guerrilla groups could still operate in small detachments, ambush patrols, and attack supply lines, while federal troops still had to clear the mountains, secure roads, and advance into central Chechnya. Fighting continued into the first quarter of 2000, when the southern positions gradually formed a more stable control corridor. Judged strictly as the 1999 Dagestan phase, the result was a Russian tactical and strategic initiative and the failure of the separatist forces to establish a base in Dagestan. Judged as part of the wider Chechen war, the 1999 result was that Russian forces opened a southern axis of advance and forced the opposing formations to retreat, not that the war had reached a final conclusion.
